rules: Explicit mapping wins; then prefix rules; an identical path matches itself; new-only paths get created; old-only paths are ORPHANS - kept and reported, never deleted. Always dry-run first.
principle: 2026.01 -> 2026.04 moves nothing. 2026.02 made the facet level OPTIONAL (shots/{seq}/{facet}/{shot}); whether a sequence gets facets is a production decision, so this map never invents one. 2026.03 stopped scaffolding ref/ under sequences and facets: an existing one stays where it is as the sequence's own dir. 2026.04 added c4d/ and lib/dcc/c4d/ to every shot: created on migrate, or by re-running shot.xml with skip-existing-files. 2026.05 added pub/versions/ to every asset: created on migrate, or by re-running asset.xml with skip-existing-files.
orphans_expected: shots/{seq}/ref (2026.01 scaffolded it; 2026.03+ does not; kept)
